description: The residents of 4616 Melrose Place begin as young Los Angeles neighbors trying to build careers and relationships, but Alison and Billy's friendship, Jane and Michael's marriage, Jake and Jo's arrival and Amanda Woodward's entrance steadily turn the courtyard into a web of overlapping loyalties.

s01e01.description: Alison needs a new roommate, bringing Billy into 4616 Melrose Place as the neighbors' romantic and professional lives begin to overlap.

s01e02.description: Billy and Alison negotiate the awkward boundaries of living together while friendship and attraction immediately complicate the arrangement.

s01e03.description: Billy asks Alison to judge his screenplay, while Jane's lost wedding ring turns a night at Shooters into a marital headache.

s01e04.description: Alison weighs attention from a co-worker as Jake takes a coffeehouse job and discovers that pride does not pay the rent.

s01e05.description: Jane receives life-changing news while Billy chases a dangerous experience simply to make his writing feel more authentic.

s01e06.description: Rhonda reconnects with an old dance friend, and Jake reluctantly asks Alison to help him prepare for his equivalency exam.

s01e07.description: Billy brings Alison home to meet his parents in Palm Springs, while Sandy lets a promising acting role inflate her ambitions.

s01e08.description: Sandy's uncomfortable date takes a disturbing turn when Paul begins following her, forcing the group to take his obsession seriously.

s01e09.description: Billy dates a single mother and confronts instant responsibility, while Jake and Sandy question whether physical chemistry is enough.

s01e10.description: After Billy is attacked, Rhonda helps him recover; Jake's birthday is disrupted by the sudden return of his estranged mother.

s01e11.description: Jane and Michael struggle through a painful loss, with Kimberly's friendship and an unexpected puppy offering a fragile change of perspective.

s01e12.description: Alison falls for an outspoken environmentalist, then discovers that his principles and private life may not align nearly as neatly as advertised.

s01e13.description: Billy challenges Alison's affair with a married man, while Jake pushes Matt to confront the men responsible for attacking him.

s01e14.description: Keith leaves his wife for Alison, Matt seeks legal help over discrimination, and Rhonda begins searching for a new roommate.

s01e15.description: Reserved newcomer Jo Reynolds moves into the complex, while Jane and Michael suspect that a friend's marriage is hiding domestic abuse.

s01e16.description: Jake and Jo grow closer as Jane and Michael seriously consider starting a family, raising new questions about both relationships.

s01e17.description: An old girlfriend tells Jake he may have a son, while Alison faces medical problems she can no longer ignore.

s01e18.description: Alison emerges from surgery with a romantic realization, and Michael experiences an eventful Christmas while delivering his first baby.

s01e19.description: Jane's younger sister Sydney arrives after dropping out of college and quickly begins inserting herself into Jane's work and home life.

s01e20.description: Jo considers returning to her former marriage, while Jane's patience with Sydney erodes as her sister becomes increasingly intrusive.

s01e21.description: Alison earns a promotion and meets formidable new boss Amanda Woodward, while Jo takes on a provocative photography assignment.

s01e22.description: Jake and Jo deepen their relationship, while Amanda's immediate attraction to Billy turns a party game into a new triangle.

s01e23.description: Alison confronts Billy about dating Amanda, and Jo proposes a practical solution when Jake's unemployment begins wearing him down.

s01e24.description: After Alison is accosted following a performance, she seeks safety with Keith, prompting Billy to leave their apartment.

s01e25.description: As their separate romances race toward commitment, both Alison and Billy begin wondering whether they are choosing the wrong partners.

s01e26.description: Billy is shaken by his father's sudden death, and the funeral becomes more complicated when both Alison and Amanda attend.

s01e27.description: Alison fights to regain her advertising position from Amanda, while Billy's embellished résumé turns into a professional liability.

s01e28.description: Kimberly admits her feelings for Michael, while Billy's new boss draws him into an increasingly personal working relationship.

s01e29.description: Money strains Jake and Jo, Jane's fashion work consumes her time, and Amanda makes sure Alison notices the new office hierarchy.

s01e30.description: Alison and Billy finally attempt a real date, while Michael faces a dangerous romantic choice on his wedding anniversary.

s01e31.description: Amanda announces that she is pregnant with Billy's child, while Jane agrees to counseling as Michael moves to the couch.

s01e32.description: The apartment building goes up for sale, Michael and Jane contemplate a restart, and threatening calls leave Alison afraid in her own home.
